|hp=78.0

|kb_resistance=0.1
|adaptable=No
|id=srparasites:sim_dragonehead
|ranged=40.0}}'''Walking Ender Dragon Heads''' are the [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Assimilated Ender Dragons]].

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned after the head of an Assimilated Ender Dragon takes enough damage.
==''Behavior''==
Walking Ender Dragon Heads are Melee and Ranged units.
*Walking Ender Dragon Head's Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*Walking Ender Dragon Head's Ranged Attack is performed by shooting a Projectile, which leaves a Dragon Breath Cloud. The Cloud inflicts the Poison and the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effects, while the Projectile inflicts the [[Viral]] Effect.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Ender Dragon Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
*Walking Ender Dragon Heads can perform small leaps in liquids.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Ender Dragon Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
